summary: Paul Lambert, 21, of Eagle River, Alaska, slipped and tumbled ~10 ft while traversing the knife's edge between Powell Peak and Thatchtop above Sky Pond (Andrews Glacier area), injuring his arm and becoming cliffed out at ~12,000 ft; he activated a PLB at 7:45 p.m. Saturday and spent the night. An RMNP hasty team reached him ~12:15 p.m. Sunday, rigged a technical lower through the steep section, and walked out with him 5 miles to the Glacier Gorge trailhead ~9:45 p.m.; helicopter ops at Sky Pond were not possible due to conditions; 40+ personnel involved.
location: Above Sky Pond, Andrews Glacier area
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Rocky Mountain Rescue; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Northern Colorado Helitack
notes: 2014-06-28 was a Saturday (weekday-verified); PLB initially gave several possible locations, rangers confirmed position on the east side of the Continental Divide via cell-phone GPS at 7:15 a.m. Sunday; Lambert was taken by a family member for further medical evaluation after the walkout. NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry appended.
